title: Genesis Australia - Electrified G80 electric page (Battery Conditioning Mode)
notes: "Battery Conditioning Mode" activates when a fast-charging station is set as the destination and can also be turned on manually. Page describes the current 94.5 kWh car (800V, 25 min 10-80 %), Australian market; it is the only Genesis page found that says how the G80 mode is started.
